name: PCI Compliance For Windows
description: The Sumo Logic App for Payment Card Industry (PCI) Compliance for Windows offers dashboards to monitor systems, account and users activity to ensure that login activity and privileged users are within the expected ranges. The PCI Compliance for Windows App covers PCI requirements 02, 06, 08 and 10.

panels.name: System Time Change
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Windows/OS/Windows ((_sourceName=Security 4616 "EventCode = 4616;") or (_sourceName=System (35 or 37) ("EventCode = 35;" or "EventCode = 37;")))
| parse "EventCode = *;" as eventCode nodrop | parse "Computer = \"*\";" as comp_name nodrop | parse "ComputerName = \"*\";" as comp_name nodrop
| parse regex "Message = \"(?<msg_summary>[^\r\.]+?)(?:\r|\.|\";)" nodrop | parse "User = \"*\"" as src_user nodrop | parse regex "Logfile = \"Security\";[\s\S]+?Account Name:\s+(?<src_user>[^\r]+?)\r[\s\S]+?Account Domain:\s+(?<src_domain>[^\r\"]+?)\r" nodrop
| comp_name as dest_host
| where eventCode in ("4616", "35", "37") 
| if (msg_summary="The system time was changed" and src_user <> "LOCAL SERVICE" and src_domain <> "NT AUTHORITY", "Critical", "Low") as Severity
| fields dest_host, src_user, src_domain, Severity, eventCode, msg_summary
| fields -_raw
| timeslice 1s
| count as eventCount by _timeslice, dest_host, src_user, src_domain, Severity, eventCode, msg_summary
| sort by Severity asc, _timeslice
